---
title: "Run PyLabRobot in your browser"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

This page runs a PyLabRobot 0.2.2 protocol **entirely in your browser** — the
Python runs on WebAssembly via [Pyodide](https://pyodide.org), with no server
behind it. The deck state is read from the running interpreter after every
operation and rendered right here in the page.

It's a proof of concept: the first load downloads Pyodide and pylabrobot
(20–60 seconds), and the renderer is a 2-D top-down view rather than the full
3-D visualizer. But the protocol below is real 0.2.2 code, executing in-browser.

::: {.callout-note title="What you're seeing"}
Grey boxes are carriers, the blue box is a 96-well plate, and each well's fill
colour is its liquid volume. Tips are green. Use the buttons to step or play
through the recording.
:::

<div id="plr-live">
  <p id="plr-status">Loading Pyodide…</p>
  <div id="plr-controls" style="display:none">
    <button id="plr-prev">‹ Prev</button>
    <button id="plr-play">Play</button>
    <button id="plr-next">Next ›</button>
    <button id="plr-restart">Restart</button>
    <span id="plr-step" style="margin-left:0.75rem"></span>
    <span id="plr-note" style="margin-left:0.75rem;font-style:italic"></span>
  </div>
  <div id="plr-svg-wrap" style="overflow:auto;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:6px;margin-top:0.5rem"></div>
  <details style="margin-top:0.5rem">
    <summary>Protocol log</summary>
    <pre id="plr-log" style="max-height:180px;overflow:auto;font-size:0.8em"></pre>
  </details>
</div>

<script type="text/x-python" id="plr-protocol">
import json
from pylabrobot.liquid_handling import LiquidHandler
from pylabrobot.liquid_handling.backends import LiquidHandlerChatterboxBackend
from pylabrobot.resources import (
    STARLetDeck, TIP_CAR_480_A00, PLT_CAR_L5AC_A00,
    cor_96_wellplate_360uL_Fb, hamilton_96_tiprack_1000uL_filter,
    set_volume_tracking,
)
set_volume_tracking(enabled=True)

def snapshot(deck):
    items = []
    for r in deck.get_all_children():
        tn = type(r).__name__
        if tn in ("TipSpot", "PlateHolder", "ResourceHolder"):
            continue
        if tn == "Well":
            kind = "well"
        elif tn == "Plate":
            kind = "plate"
        elif tn.endswith("Carrier"):
            kind = "carrier"
        elif tn == "TipRack":
            kind = "tiprack"
        else:
            kind = "other"
        al = r.get_absolute_location()
        tr = getattr(r, "tracker", None)
        items.append({
            "name": r.name, "kind": kind, "type": tn,
            "x": round(al.x, 1), "y": round(al.y, 1),
            "w": round(r.get_size_x(), 1), "h": round(r.get_size_y(), 1),
            "vol": getattr(tr, "volume", None),
            "max": getattr(tr, "max_volume", None),
        })
    return items

async def run():
    deck = STARLetDeck()
    tip_c = TIP_CAR_480_A00(name="tips")
    plt_c = PLT_CAR_L5AC_A00(name="plates")
    deck.assign_child_resource(plt_c, rails=5)
    deck.assign_child_resource(tip_c, rails=11)
    tip_c[0] = hamilton_96_tiprack_1000uL_filter(name="tips_0")
    plt_c[0] = cor_96_wellplate_360uL_Fb(name="plate_0")

    lh = LiquidHandler(backend=LiquidHandlerChatterboxBackend(), deck=deck)
    await lh.setup()

    snaps = []
    plate_0 = deck.get_resource("plate_0")
    plate_0.set_well_volumes([200.0] * 96)
    snaps.append(snapshot(deck))

    tips = deck.get_resource("tips_0")
    await lh.pick_up_tips(tips["A1"])
    snaps.append(snapshot(deck))
    await lh.aspirate(plate_0["A1"], vols=[50])
    snaps.append(snapshot(deck))
    await lh.dispense(plate_0["B1"], vols=[50])
    snaps.append(snapshot(deck))
    await lh.pick_up_tips(tips["A2"])
    snaps.append(snapshot(deck))
    await lh.aspirate(plate_0["C1"], vols=[120])
    snaps.append(snapshot(deck))
    await lh.dispense(plate_0["D1"], vols=[120])
    snaps.append(snapshot(deck))
    await lh.return_tips()
    snaps.append(snapshot(deck))
    await lh.stop()

    return json.dumps(snaps)
</script>

<script>
window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async function () {
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const status = $("plr-status");
  const controls = $("plr-controls");
  const log = $("plr-log");
  const svgWrap = $("plr-svg-wrap");
  const stepEl = $("plr-step");
  const noteEl = $("plr-note");
  const PROTOCOL = $("plr-protocol").textContent;

  const setStatus = (t) => { status.textContent = t; };

  function render(snaps, index) {
    const items = snaps[index];
    if (!items) return;
    const pad = 20;
    let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    for (const it of items) {
      minX = Math.min(minX, it.x); minY = Math.min(minY, it.y);
      maxX = Math.max(maxX, it.x + it.w); maxY = Math.max(maxY, it.y + it.h);
    }
    minX -= pad; minY -= pad; maxX += pad; maxY += pad;
    const width = Math.max(400, maxX - minX);
    const height = Math.max(200, maxY - minY);
    const scale = Math.min(900 / width, 500 / height, 2.5);
    const W = (maxX - minX) * scale, H = (maxY - minY) * scale;
    const sx = (x) => (x - minX) * scale;
    const sy = (y) => (maxY - y) * scale;

    let svg = `<svg width="${W}" height="${H}" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block">`;
    svg += `<rect x="0" y="0" width="${W}" height="${H}" fill="#f6f8fa"/>`;
    for (const it of items) {
      const x = sx(it.x), y = sy(it.y + it.h), w = it.w * scale, h = it.h * scale;
      if (it.kind === "carrier") {
        svg += `<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${h}" rx="6" fill="#e2e8f0" stroke="#94a3b8"/>`;
        svg += `<text x="${x + 6}" y="${y + 14}" font-size="11" fill="#475569">${it.name}</text>`;
      } else if (it.kind === "tiprack") {
        svg += `<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${h}" rx="4" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#4ade80"/>`;
        svg += `<text x="${x + 4}" y="${y + 12}" font-size="10" fill="#166534">${it.name}</text>`;
      } else if (it.kind === "plate") {
        svg += `<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${h}" rx="4" fill="#dbeafe" stroke="#60a5fa"/>`;
        svg += `<text x="${x + 4}" y="${y + 12}" font-size="10" fill="#1e40af">${it.name}</text>`;
      } else if (it.kind === "well") {
        const f = it.max ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, it.vol / it.max)) : 0;
        const r = Math.max(1.5, (Math.min(it.w, it.h) / 2) * scale * 0.9);
        const a = 0.12 + 0.78 * f;
        svg += `<circle cx="${x + w / 2}" cy="${y + h / 2}" r="${r}" fill="rgba(37,99,235,${a})" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="0.5"/>`;
      }
    }
    svg += "</svg>";
    svgWrap.innerHTML = svg;
    stepEl.textContent = `step ${index + 1} / ${snaps.length}`;
    noteEl.textContent = index === 0 ? "deck set up, plate filled" :
      index === 1 ? "pick up tip A1" :
      index === 2 ? "aspirate 50 µL from A1" :
      index === 3 ? "dispense 50 µL into B1" :
      index === 4 ? "pick up tip A2" :
      index === 5 ? "aspirate 120 µL from C1" :
      index === 6 ? "dispense 120 µL into D1" :
      "return tips, done";
  }

  let snaps = null;
  try {
    setStatus("Loading Pyodide (first load may take a while)…");
    const pyodide = await loadPyodide();
    setStatus("Loading ssl + micropip…");
    await pyodide.loadPackage(["ssl", "micropip"]);
    setStatus("Installing pylabrobot 0.2.2…");
    await pyodide.runPythonAsync("import micropip; await micropip.install('pylabrobot==0.2.2')");
    pyodide.setStdout({ batched: (s) => { log.textContent += s + "\n"; } });
    setStatus("Running the protocol…");
    const raw = await pyodide.runPythonAsync(PROTOCOL);
    snaps = JSON.parse(raw);
    log.textContent += "snapshots: " + snaps.length + "\n";
    controls.style.display = "block";
    status.textContent = "Done.";
    status.style.display = "none";
  } catch (e) {
    status.textContent = "Error: " + e.message;
    return;
  }

  let idx = 0, timer = null;
  const show = (i) => { idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(snaps.length - 1, i)); render(snaps, idx); };
  const stop = () => { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; $("plr-play").textContent = "Play"; } };

  $("plr-prev").onclick = () => { stop(); show(idx - 1); };
  $("plr-next").onclick = () => { stop(); show(idx + 1); };
  $("plr-restart").onclick = () => { stop(); show(0); };
  $("plr-play").onclick = () => {
    if (timer) { stop(); return; }
    $("plr-play").textContent = "Pause";
    timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (idx >= snaps.length - 1) { stop(); return; }
      show(idx + 1);
    }, 1200);
  };

  show(0);
});
</script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.26.4/full/pyodide.js"></script>
